faq.title: AJV6D XJ Questions
faq.description: Answers covering costs, engine codes, warranty and fitting for the Jaguar XJ AJV6D diesel engine.

faqs.q: Is the AJV6D the same as the 306DT?
faqs.a: Yes, both refer to the same 3.0 V6 diesel. AJV6D is the engineering name, and 306DT is the code most parts catalogues use. We still verify your exact version using the VIN.

faqs.q: How much is a Jaguar XJ AJV6D engine replacement?
faqs.a: The price depends on whether you choose used, reconditioned or rebuilt, and whether we install it. Send your registration and we'll provide an itemised quote in writing.

faqs.q: Do your AJV6D engines include warranty cover?
faqs.a: Yes. Every engine we supply carries a six-month mechanical warranty. We'll explain what it covers and any conditions, including those for outside fitting, before you order.

faqs.q: Was there a 211hp AJV6D in the XJ?
faqs.a: Catalogue data shows the XJ's AJV6D at 275hp and 300hp only. The 211hp tune is listed for other models, so we confirm your output before matching a replacement.

faqs.q: Could a 1996 Jaguar XJ have an AJV6D?
faqs.a: No. The 1996 XJ had no diesel option, and the later X350's diesel was the 2.7-litre AJD-V6. The AJV6D belongs to the X351, introduced from late 2009.

faqs.q: What are common Jaguar XJ AJV6D engine problems?
faqs.a: Reported issues include crankshaft bearing wear, crank damper failure, secondary turbo faults and oil cooler leaks. Because symptoms overlap, a full diagnosis should come before any repair decision.

faqs.q: What happens during your AJV6D supply and fit service?
faqs.a: At our Grays, Essex workshop we remove the failed diesel, fit the replacement, refill fluids, complete any software setup and road test your XJ. Timescales are confirmed with your quote.

paragraphs: Your Jaguar XJ AJV6D engine replacement cost reflects the engine type, its history and whether we carry out the fitting. Removing a V6 diesel from a long-bodied saloon takes real labour, so compare complete supply and fit quotes rather than engine prices alone.

When reading AJV6D 3.0 V6 diesel engine UK listings, ask whether the unit came from an XJ, an XF or a Land Rover. Sumps and ancillaries can differ, so confirm donor model, mileage and pre-sale checks.

Check the warranty last but never skip it. A Jaguar XJ AJV6D engine with warranty gives cover if a mechanical fault develops after fitting. Engines we supply include a six-month mechanical warranty, with any conditions explained before you buy.

engineProblems.title: Jaguar XJ AJV6D Engine Problems Owners Notice
engineProblems.description: Treat these as possible signs only; a proper diagnosis confirms the fault.

cards.title: Rumbling Bottom End
cards.description: A deep rumble or knock that sharpens as revs rise could indicate crankshaft bearing wear, a known concern on this diesel.
cards.action: Switch off and arrange recovery today.

cards.title: Boost Fades at Speed
cards.description: Strong low-speed pull followed by a flat spot may point to the secondary turbo, its actuator or vacuum lines.

cards.title: Front-End Vibration
cards.description: Unusual shaking at idle or a wobble at the front pulley could suggest the crankshaft damper is breaking down.
cards.action: Get the pulley and belts inspected.

cards.title: Leaks in the Valley
cards.description: Oil or coolant collecting between the cylinder banks may come from a leaking oil cooler or coolant pipe.
cards.action: Have the leak traced before it spreads.

cards.title: Hard or Slow Starting
cards.description: Extended cranking or rough running after start-up might relate to injector, fuel pressure or sensor faults needing investigation.
cards.action: Request a fuel system diagnostic check.

cards.title: DPF Light Keeps Returning
cards.description: Particulate filter warnings that come back repeatedly may mean regeneration isn't finishing, especially on mostly short journeys.
cards.action: Book a DPF and EGR inspection.

engineOverview.title: What AJV6D Means for Your X351 Jaguar XJ
paragraphs: AJV6D is the engineering label for the 2,993cc V6 diesel badged 3.0 SDV6 in the X351 XJ. Parts catalogues usually file the same engine under 306DT, which is why both names appear in listings. It runs common-rail injection with twin turbochargers and sends drive to the rear wheels.

Catalogue data lists the XJ's AJV6D at 275hp from late 2009, with a 300hp version from 2015. A Jaguar XJ 3.0 V6 diesel engine 211hp listing therefore needs care, because the 155kW tune appears in XF and Land Rover data rather than XJ specifications.

Searching for a Jaguar XJ AJV6D engine 1996 will not lead to a match. The XJ of that year was petrol-only, and its first diesel, the 2.7-litre AJD-V6, did not appear until the X350. We confirm your engine from the VIN before quoting.
